resources.string: 3.0.4 · Sky catalogue, store compatibility and music metadata cache

Added the missing requested traditional star names and retained Polaris under its Chinese name, Gouxian Yi. The Pleiades and Andromeda Galaxy remain existing objects and are not duplicated. Increased spacing between weather-map choices and the browser link. Returning from Device Messaging notification settings now preserves the page position, and the Home buttons in Music, Device Messaging and Color Vision are narrower. Music import history shows completed files correctly, while empty playlists and Favorites explain that the selected collection is empty. The app store rejects internal apps newer than the installed toolbox and can check for, download and hand a stable toolbox update to Android for confirmation. Music metadata is reread only when its filename, MIME type, size or modification time changes, and manually edited track details are retained.
